title: El Luto de Tacámbaro, MEXITV
comment: luto-tacambaro (MEXITV): velorio de noche en la sala grande de una casa de rancho en Tacámbaro, Michoacán, ya sin gente. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista aunque todos van de negro.

chars.ALTAGRACIA_SOTELO: Mexican woman, the quiet widow of a powerful rancher, 54 years old, light-brown skin, dark hair with grey streaks pulled back in a low bun, a thin black lace mantilla veil over her hair, calm sharp dark eyes, a long-sleeved black dress, a single-strand pearl necklace, her hands empty.
chars.PRISCILIANO_SOTELO: Mexican man, the dead rancher's ambitious older brother, 60 years old, heavyset, tanned skin, short grey hair, a thick grey mustache, a black western suit with a white shirt and a silver bolo tie, a gold watch, no hat, his hands empty.
chars.MOISES_RANGEL: Mexican man, the dead rancher's right-hand man, 42 years old, brown skin, shaved head, a short black beard, a serious face, a black leather jacket over a black shirt, dark jeans, his hands empty.
chars.ARELI_CAMPOS: Mexican woman, the dead rancher's secret lover, 31 years old, fair-olive skin, long wavy auburn hair, red lipstick, teary eyes, a fitted black knee-length dress, small gold earrings, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_VELORIOTACAMBARO: Large living room of an old ranch house in Tacambaro, Michoacan, late at night during a wake after the mourners have left: a closed dark wooden coffin at the back on a stand, big arrangements of white lilies and white gladiolas, tall lit candles, rows of empty folding chairs, terracotta tile floor, white walls with dark wooden beams, warm dim candlelight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
